newsitem.title: USA: LPC - US ONE taps Goldman for $150 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - US ONE taps Goldman for $150 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 23 (LPC) - Goldman Sachs & Co Inc is leading a $150 million bank loan backing US ONE Communications, market sources said.
The bank loan, will be used for general corporate purposes.

It comes in conjunction with a high-yield offering in excess of $200 million that is being led by Goldman Sachs as manager and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette and Morgan Stanley Group Inc as co-managers, according to bankers.
